name: The Westin Pasadena
positioning: The Westin Pasadena: a wellness-focused hotel near Old Town Pasadena at the foot of the San Gabriel Mountains, with a heated rooftop pool and rooms with mountain or historic Pasadena views
best_for: Travelers who want a base near Old Town Pasadena and the Rose Bowl

facts.text: The hotel is near Old Town Pasadena, the Pasadena Convention Center, the Civic Auditorium and the Rose Bowl Stadium.
Rooms and suites have the Westin Heavenly Bed, and many have patio, courtyard or mountain views.
Each guestroom has a mini-fridge and Starbucks coffee.
The Presidential Suite is a one-bedroom suite with a balcony.
Pet-friendly suites have a Heavenly Dog Bed and other special amenities.
The hotel is pet-friendly, allowing up to two pets of up to 40 pounds each.
The WestinWORKOUT Fitness Studio is open 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
Hollywood Burbank Airport is the closest airport, about 16 miles from the hotel.

highlights.text: The heated rooftop pool has views of Historic Old Town, Pasadena City Hall and the San Gabriel Mountains.
The hotel sits at the foot of the San Gabriel Mountains.
Rooms offer views of the San Gabriel Mountains or historic Pasadena.
The Walnut suite is a larger one-bedroom suite with a mountain view.
Ventanas serves California cuisine and has a sun-dappled patio with courtyard views for outdoor dining.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
Self-parking does not have in and out privileges.
WhataHotel notes that reaching downtown Los Angeles attractions requires a drive or rideshare.
